env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd positive
logos run -p=1 .
stdout '^ok scope-position$'
cd ../negative
! logos build -p=1 .

-- positive/go.mod --
module example.com/scopepositive

go 1.27

-- positive/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

var value int

func finish() { value = 7 }

func exercise() {
	{
		scope defer finish()
	}
	if value != 7 {
		panic(value)
	}
}

func main() {
	exercise()
	fmt.Println("ok scope-position")
}

-- negative/go.mod --
module example.com/scopenegative

go 1.27

-- negative/main.lgo --
package main

func finish() {}

func main() {
	scope finish()
}
